QpqUiMyTier = {
	type = character
	log_loc_errors = no
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init exists = var:qpq_ui_agent_tier var:qpq_ui_agent_tier <= 0 has_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_0
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } exists = var:qpq_ui_payer_tier var:qpq_ui_payer_tier <= 0 has_variable = qpq_ui_o_charter }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_0
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init exists = var:qpq_ui_agent_tier var:qpq_ui_agent_tier <= 0 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_1
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } exists = var:qpq_ui_payer_tier var:qpq_ui_payer_tier <= 0 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_1
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init var:qpq_ui_agent_tier ?= 1 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_1
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } var:qpq_ui_payer_tier ?= 1 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_1
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init var:qpq_ui_agent_tier ?= 2 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_2
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } var:qpq_ui_payer_tier ?= 2 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_2
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init var:qpq_ui_agent_tier ?= 3 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_3
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } var:qpq_ui_payer_tier ?= 3 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_3
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init var:qpq_ui_agent_tier ?= 4 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_4
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } var:qpq_ui_payer_tier ?= 4 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_4
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init var:qpq_ui_agent_tier ?= 5 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_5
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init } var:qpq_ui_payer_tier ?= 5 }
		localization_key = qpq_tier_5
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = qpq_empty
	}
}

QpqUiGoldLine = {
	type = character
	log_loc_errors = no
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = qpq_ui_o_gold } }
		localization_key = qpq_empty
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_timing ?= flag:on_delivery }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_GOLD_ON_DELIVERY
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_timing ?= flag:split }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_GOLD_SPLIT
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_timing ?= flag:stipend }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_GOLD_STIPEND
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_GOLD_UP_FRONT
	}
}

QpqUiAcceptance = {
	type = character
	log_loc_errors = no
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { exists = var:qpq_ui_acc_total } }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_NONE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_recipient = { is_ai = no } }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_PLAYER
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_acc_total > 0 }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_YES
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_NO
	}
}
